registered_before: Fetching the full development archive and scoring any eleven-component cases
baseline: Unmodified V8 numeric CPI route, including V7 in-corpus selector and residual intervals
submission_gate: Unchanged: lower endpoint of paired 95% CI >= +0.10 on the fixed-weight full-track analogue. CPI weight is 0.10; all unchanged families contribute zero. This development pilot cannot authorize a submission.

development.fit: Annual expanding window; targets must have been released before January 1 of each evaluation year

confirmation: CPI 2017-2021 remains unopened. No confirmation until complete coverage, input equivalence, frozen model and an attainable full-track gate are established. V10 COT confirmation is consumed development and cannot be reused as fresh.
source: Original BLS monthly news releases preserved by FRASER, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Use PDF embargo header, not FRASER item metadata, as publication date. Record SHA256, source URL, table and line for every extracted row.
availability: Month-end forecast before target CPI release. Nine preceding monthly SA rates reconstructed only from releases available by cutoff. Current-month EIA weekly gasoline with two-day publication buffer. Exclude only missing or ambiguous required inputs; retain all forecast errors.
limitations: Published changes rounded to 0.1 percentage point, unlike index-derived targets
Three-month table histories may miss annual seasonal revisions to older months
EIA historical archive is not certified original release vintages
Local fixed naive reference is not the unknown competition reference
Numeric composite does not include production citation/NLI or leaderboard aggregation
hypotheses: Gasoline bridge with causal month effects; shrink volatile energy without oversmoothing shelter
Residual-calibrated intervals based only on in-corpus or pre-cutoff errors
Reconcile headline, food, energy and core using component weights available in supplied corpus; otherwise omit reconciliation
metric: Unmodified official numeric regression composite 5.2.2, fixed mean3 point and +/-1 interval naive reference. Pair by month; primary equal-quarter mean and two-quarter circular block bootstrap, seed10, 20000 draws. Report MAE, component MAE, interval coverage and exclusions. Development intervals are descriptive after model selection.
